|rulings=* Must deploy to a specific [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] on table (may be unique or non-unique, and must belong to Dark). This site, and any cards at it, are lost when that [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] is lost.<ref name="scomp">[https://web.archive.org/web/20010613021619/http://www.decipher.com:80/starwars/rules/pdf/swccgglossary.pdf Decipher Glossary Version 2.0], November 1998, p. 136, "vehicle sites"; [https://web.archive.org/web/20260422134639/https://res.starwarsccg.org/rules/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf SWCCG 2023 Advanced Rulebook], p. 85, "Starship Sites and Vehicle Sites" (Players Committee). Archived rules sources; distinct from the original printed card face.</ref>
* This site is 'adjacent' to the site where the [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] vehicle is (for example, [[Expand The Empire]] can expand text to or from here).
* This site is 'related' to all sites on the same planet that the [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] is on.
* This site does ''not'' take on the name of the planet (e.g. it is not a [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]] site, a character here is not 'on [[Tatooine (Dark) (Premiere){{!}}Tatooine]]' or 'on Cloud City' even if the [[Sandcrawler (Dark){{!}}Sandcrawler]] is, etc).

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered Revised card, [[Sandcrawler: Droid Junkheap (Revised)]] (September 1998).
